outcomes.name: Start in Cowork
outcomes.observable: A first-time learner reaches Prework, creates an empty training folder, and starts Cowork with that folder using the public workbook, without cloning a repository, installing developer tools, or opening a separate Teacher task.

outcomes.name: Install the starter
outcomes.observable: The learner places the starter in the training folder; the agent extracts it and confirms the required homes while preserving existing learner work. Missing or misplaced archives produce a recovery request rather than a fabricated success. The archive contains no root instructions or facilitator material. Installation creates or augments CLAUDE.md with only the course-navigation reading cue, preserves existing instructions, and reads prework/course-navigation.md.

outcomes.name: Return to the workbook
outcomes.observable: A completed checkpoint request returns a usable link to the relevant workbook section, preserves human follow-through and current revisions, and stops before starting the next activity. Snake returns for playing, packaging preserves the interpretation sections, and the cold critic returns for learner comparison.

outcomes.name: Use personal context
outcomes.observable: The learner supplies personal material and decisions that shape the M1 output. Course navigation supplies neither an invented profile nor personal or generation rules. M1 generation rules stay at module-1/personal-brand-generation.md. Before the canonical M2 debrief, installation adds only a course-navigation reading cue to CLAUDE.md and preserves any existing learner instructions; the learner authors the actual working rules in the M2 debrief.

outcomes.name: Pause unfinished work
outcomes.observable: On pause, the agent saves the current section, completed requests, unfinished learner actions, revision notes and next action at prework/learning-position.md without changing exercise outputs or root instructions. An output file being written does not imply that playing, comparing, approving or revising it is complete.

outcomes.name: Resume a fresh task
outcomes.observable: A fresh task with the same training folder and no previous scrollback reads the saved navigation and position, returns the current link for unfinished work or the recorded next link for explicitly completed work, and performs no exercise or output mutation during recovery.

outcomes.name: Recover uncertain progress
outcomes.observable: Without a position note, resume links to Prework and asks where the learner stopped. With a title-only note, it gives the workbook base and saved title. With conflicting evidence or a learner correction to stale progress, it names the uncertainty, asks one question and waits, without inventing progress or silently advancing.

outcomes.name: Keep navigation local
outcomes.observable: Course navigation requires no course account, sends no position or exercise report, and adds no identity parameters to return links. A pause note excludes names, company identifiers and source-document contents even when those appear in the working conversation.
